title: Setting up a Warehouse of Physiological Data and Biomedical Signals in Adult Intensive Care
official: Setting up a Warehouse of Physiological Data and Biomedical Signals in Adult Intensive Care
summary: The aim of this study is the establishment of a warehouse physiological data and biomedical signal in intensive care adult patients in acute situations from particular records from the Philips Intellivue MP70 monitor.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any adult patient admitted in Brest University Hospital's intensive care unit for monitoring of vital failure

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refusal to participate
